lead_time.note: No target, so no lead time. The only generator-related observation is a status line saying construction-power generators were already delivered and commissioned (recorded in later_procurement_events); it is not a procurement event and it post-dates the real procurement decision.

blockers: Target set to null (reviewer: 'generators delivered and commissioned' is a status line, not a solicitation or award, with no rent-vs-buy or vendor detail); the line is kept as text in later_procurement_events. Case stays a target_fit-review candidate, not a negative.
AMEC EPCM award date (2014) not independently captured; s3 timestamp is the 2015 MD&A that restates it.
No temporary-power solicitation found; BC Hydro grid (NTL tap) was the permanent plan so generator need was a construction-phase bridge (inference, not from a quote).
Earlier 2013 technical report 6-K (0001199835-13-000387) exists but was not used.
All dates on 6-Ks use EDGAR acceptance time; the acceptance time for 0001199835-14-000325 precedes its 2014-06-23 filing date (accepted on a Friday evening).
reviewer_checklist: Confirm 20 MW BC Hydro limit is in the FS section 16.9.4 and still applied in the 2015 updated FS.
Look for the Q1/Q2 2015 statements that first mention ordering the construction power generators (an earlier, better target); none was found in the Q2 2015 capture.
Confirm AMEC EPCM award date and obtain its announcement timestamp.
